labels.name: Epidermis
labels.function: Keratinocyte layer where precursor atypia is confined

labels.name: Scale-crust
labels.function: Yellow surface layer over a base with no thickness or nodularity

labels.name: Actinic keratosis
labels.function: Partial-thickness atypia; may regress, persist or progress

labels.name: Basement membrane
labels.function: Boundary malignant cells cross when a lesion becomes invasive

labels.name: Dermis
labels.function: Layer holding tumor islands only once a lesion is invasive

labels.name: Squamous cell carcinoma in situ
labels.function: Full-thickness atypia within the epidermis only

labels.name: Invasive squamous cell carcinoma
labels.function: Atypical keratinocyte nests that have broken into the dermis

labels.name: Keratin pearl
labels.function: Whorled keratin flakes inside a nest of atypical cells
